message: 冬のアナタ

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haaah... It really has gotten cold~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Dropping temperatures... We never had changes like this in Heaven」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san came to the Human World, and now we're facing our first winter...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What I saw today really must be, at least in part, because we came to the Human World--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! Azel-san! I've been waiting for you!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You don't need to be so on guard. There's no one else here besides me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How is your body feeling?」

name: Azel
message: 「Fine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But it might flare up again right away, mightn't it...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hasn't your condition been pretty poor ever since we came here?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Honestly! Why do you talk like that?! Are you saying you don't care what happens to your body?」

name: Azel
message: 「I said it's nothing... ngh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「See! Just as I thought...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san... You haven't been able to adapt to the environment here, have you」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what is it?!」

name: Azel
message: 「It has nothing to do with you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It does have something to do with me! We're--」

name: Azel
message: 「This is my problem. Leave it alone」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can't do that!」

name: Azel
message: 「Then worry about yourself for once」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm fine. I've been in the Human World way longer than you, Azel-san, and see... my health is in top shape♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why does everyone keep doing reckless things without caring about their own well-being...」

name: Azel
message: 「Everyone... you say?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Actually, Amyrina came too. To the Human World」

name: Azel
message: 「Amyrina...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's my childhood friend」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though she came all the way to the Human World, all she ever does is follow me around...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What on earth is she going to do if she can't adapt to the Human World and gets sick!」

name: Azel
message: 「Have you never considered the possibility that you wouldn't be able to adapt either?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I came here prepared. No matter what happens to me. Since I'm coming to the Human World, that much is only natural」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you trying to say that I lack resolve?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-No, that's not what I meant...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But Amyrina is different! From the very beginning, she kept saying the Human World was dangerous... That's why she refused to come with me, and yet...」

name: Azel
message: 「It means Amyrina also came with a fitting resolve of her own... I imagine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For what purpose...?」

name: Azel
message: 「She's following after you, isn't she?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...! C-Could that mean...」

name: Azel
message: 「...Her worry for your well-being is the same as yours for hers. No matter what happens to herself」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina... No way...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! Hey, Azel-san! Don't just walk off like that!」

name: Azel
message: 「Our talk is over. There is no issue」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still...」

name: Azel
message: 「I have my own mission. And the resolve to see it through」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san... What on earth are you doing this for...?」

name: Azel
message: 「It has nothing to do with you. Take Amyrina and go back at once. To Heaven」
